machine: Apple M3, 16 GB, macOS 26.3.1, loaded (swap 12-13 of 14 GB)
command: bench/rawtherapee/compare.sh <out> <the eight CC0 samples read by both> (RawTherapee 5.13, Homebrew)
note: both judged against their own unclipped develop with the same scorer (bench/rawtherapee/score.py): 16-bit sRGB two stops down, the mask = pixels the clip changed by over 1 %, less those the truth itself clipped; pixel-weighted over the eight frames. Fotollection's baseline 'off' is the fade (White), RawTherapee's is no reconstruction (each channel clipped).

wholeDevelop.note: one frame, wall time and peak RSS from /usr/bin/time -l. Fotollection: raw_memory own (decode, develop, finish to 8-bit, no file written). RawTherapee: rawtherapee-cli, neutral profile, AMaZE, a 16-bit TIFF written, process start included.
